summary: To use your own override of an ansible.builtin module while using FQCNs, reference it through ansible.legacy, for example ansible.legacy.copy.
questions: How do I call my custom copy module instead of the builtin one when using FQCN?

answer_card.title: Override builtin modules with ansible.legacy
answer_card.answer_md: Use `ansible.legacy` in the FQCN. For a custom `copy` module, call `ansible.legacy.copy`; `ansible.builtin.copy` always means the shipped one.
